architecture.currentStage: Local development with mock ecommerce metrics and mock assistant replies.
architecture.v1Scope: Single founder workspace using Triple Whale as the only business data source and Claude as server-side assistant.
architecture.futureSaasDirection: Multi-workspace subscription product where each customer has isolated data.
architecture.dataOwnershipRule: Code can be updated safely; customer data remains protected in PostgreSQL and tied to workspace_id.
